title: Joe Tippmann’s $62 million extension serves to bolster Jets’ offensive line stability

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joe Tippmann’s $62 million extension serves to bolster Jets’ offensive line stability
sources.description: The Jets inked the 2023 second-round pick to a four-year, $62 million extension that includes $31 million in guarantees, making him the 15th-highest-paid guard in the NFL.
